destinations.name: Mathura
destinations.description: The sacred birthplace of Lord Krishna. Famous for Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, ancient ghats along the Yamuna river, Dwarkadhish temple, and Mathura ke Pede.
destinations.popular_for: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, Dwarkadhish Mandir, Vishram Ghat Yamuna Aarti, Kans Qila, Birla Mandir

destinations.name: Vrindavan
destinations.description: The divine town of Lord Krishna and Radha Rani. Home to Banke Bihari Mandir, Prem Mandir lighting, ISKCON, and Nidhivan.
destinations.popular_for: Banke Bihari Mandir, Prem Mandir Musical Fountain & Light Show, ISKCON Temple, Radha Raman Mandir, Nidhivan, Kesi Ghat

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.description: World-famous city of the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and historic Mughal architecture. Located just 1 hour from Mathura.
destinations.popular_for: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri Buland Darwaza, Mehtab Bagh, Agra Petha Market

destinations.name: Ayodhya
destinations.description: The holy birthplace of Lord Shri Ram. Experience the grand Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Hanuman Garhi, and Saryu Aarti.
destinations.popular_for: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, Saryu River Aarti, Dashrath Mahal, Ram Ki Paidi

destinations.name: Varanasi (Kashi)
destinations.description: The world’s oldest living city. Sacred Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga, grand evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, and Sarnath.
destinations.popular_for: Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, Dashashwamedh Ghat Ganga Aarti, Assi Ghat Subah-e-Banaras, Sarnath Buddhist Stupa, Banarasi Silk Markets

destinations.name: Haridwar
destinations.description: Gateway to the Gods. Witness the divine Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri and visit Mansa Devi & Chandi Devi hill temples.
destinations.popular_for: Har Ki Pauri Evening Ganga Aarti, Mansa Devi Ropeway, Chandi Devi Mandir, Maya Devi, Shantikunj

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.description: Yoga capital of the world in the Himalayan foothills. River rafting on the Ganga, Lakshman Jhula, and peaceful ashrams.
destinations.popular_for: White Water River Rafting, Triveni Ghat Aarti, Ram Jhula, Lakshman Jhula, Beatles Ashram, Cliff Jumping & Riverside Camping

destinations.name: Jaipur (Pink City)
destinations.description: The royal Pink City of Rajasthan. Explore grand Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and traditional Rajasthani culture.
destinations.popular_for: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jal Mahal, Nahargarh Fort Sunset, Chokhi Dhani Ethnic Village, Bapu Bazaar

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.description: Scenic Himalayan mountain valley with pine forests, snow peaks, Solang Valley adventure sports, and the Atal Tunnel.
destinations.popular_for: Solang Valley Snow Point, Atal Tunnel & Sissu, Hadimba Devi Mandir, Old Manali Cafes, Mall Road, Rohtang Pass

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.description: Sun, sand, beautiful palm-fringed beaches, Portuguese heritage churches, and refreshing coastal travel.
destinations.popular_for: Baga & Calangute Beaches, Dudhsagar Waterfalls, Basilica of Bom Jesus, Fort Aguada, Sunset Cruise

destinations.name: Kedarnath
destinations.description: One of the holy 12 Jyotirlingas and the sacred crown of the Himalayas in the Mandakini river valley.
destinations.popular_for: Kedarnath Jyotirlinga Temple, Bhairavnath Mandir, Mandakini Valley, Gaurikund Trek

destinations.name: Shimla
destinations.description: The classic British summer capital with colonial architecture, Mall Road, Christ Church, and pine mountain vistas.
destinations.popular_for: Mall Road & The Ridge, Christ Church, Jakhu Hanuman Temple, Kufri Snow View, Toy Train

destinations.name: Nainital
destinations.description: Picturesque Lake City of Kumaon. Boating on pear-shaped Naini Lake, Naina Devi Mandir, and mountain ropeway.
destinations.popular_for: Naini Lake Boating, Naina Devi Mandir, Snow View Point Ropeway, Mallital Market, Bhimtal

destinations.name: Tirupati (Balaji)
destinations.description: The sacred Seven Hills of Tirumala, home to Lord Sri Venkateswara Balaji Swamy.
destinations.popular_for: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Tirumala), Padmavathi Ammavari Temple, Kapila Theertham

destinations.name: Puri (Jagannath Puri)
destinations.description: One of the Char Dham holy tirthas. Sacred Jagannath Temple, Puri Golden Beach, and Konark Sun Temple.
destinations.popular_for: Shri Jagannath Mandir, Puri Golden Beach, Konark Sun Temple, Chilika Lake Dolphin Tour
